title: ACCRINTM: an on-record live-Excel comparison, with no count and no corpus
status_plain: ACCRINTM has an on-record live-Excel comparison and no number. It appears twice in the ACCRINT half-value stream, both times as a qualitative verdict: it matched on equivalent inputs and was not affected, and the defect is specific to periodic ACCRINT. That is exactly the weight of evidence that earns the six COUP* surfaces their standing, and it comes from the same similar-risk scan in the same run on the same build. The record exists so ACCRINTM is not silently treated as having no Excel comparison at all. Critically, ACCRINTM is explicitly EXCLUDED from every ACCRINT figure: no part of ACCRINT's 145,607 of 145,620, and no part of its b39, b40 or b42 gates, belongs here.

counts.build_note: The stream's Ref notes state "live Excel COM, Excel `16.0` build `20026`, workbook" at line 14. That is a header field, not the sentence carrying this verdict, and it is an OLDER build than the 20131 the W109 ACCRINT work used. Not inherited.
counts.corpus_or_build: the similar-risk scan run alongside the ACCRINT half-value investigation; the source names no corpus size
counts.ambiguity_note: QUALITATIVE VERDICT ONLY. No numerator, no denominator, no corpus size, no enumeration of the "equivalent inputs". The comparison happened and is on record; what it scored is not published. It may never be turned into a pass rate, and it may never be filled in from ACCRINT's numbers.
counts.source_sentence:
## Similar-Risk Scan
- `ACCRINTM` matched on equivalent inputs (not affected).

evidence_locality_note: The similar-risk scan has no tracked corpus artifact at commit 473efa3; the stream records the verdict, not the run.
open_question: The source never states how many ACCRINTM inputs were compared, so no count can be extracted and none should be invented.
reader_warning: A qualitative verdict, not a count, on the older build 20026. ACCRINTM is explicitly excluded from ACCRINT's figures -- "the defect is specific to periodic `ACCRINT`" -- so none of ACCRINT's 25,410, 51,420, 68,790 or 145,620 rows may be credited to it.
